acceptance_predicates.description: Paired TUI qualification consumes deterministic ASB control-state evidence without cross-test collisions.
No TUI product change is introduced unless a paired lifecycle defect is evidenced.
Missing development authentication, signatures, and key management remain warning-only.

definition_of_done: ASB repair or rerun evidence is recorded and paired qualification is unblocked.

inputs.description: ASB control-state ownership and recovery evidence.

gates.description: Exact-head paired qualification is not blocked by cross-test state collisions.
